title: celtis biondii var. heterophylla
intro: Celtis biondii var. heterophylla, commonly known as Akebi, is a plant species in the family Cannabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to promote health and well-being, with reported health benefits including the reduction of blood sugar levels and the alleviation of symptoms associated with cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Akebi include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its ability to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes and scavenge free radicals. The bioactive constituents of Akebi include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
